HOW_TO_READ.TITLE: How to read this chart
HOW_TO_READ.AVG: The line is the average of the readings in each time step
HOW_TO_READ.RANGE: The shaded band shows the lowest and the highest reading in each time step
HOW_TO_READ.LIMITS: The dashed lines are the limits of the metric. The alarm limits are shown, and a click on the legend shows or hides the warning limits
HOW_TO_READ.SIGNALS: Colored areas behind the plot mark the signals. Signals that overlap share one area in the color of the highest severity. Point at an area to read the rules and times of its signals
HOW_TO_READ.ZOOM: Drag over the plot or use the mouse wheel to zoom into the time axis. Hold Shift and drag to move. Use Reset zoom to go back
